faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
faq.subtitle: Pure client-side offline tools platform providing authoritative privacy and security guarantees
faq.badge: 100% Local Browser Computing · Zero Server-side Privacy Leakage
faq.q1: Is Super Toolbox Pro completely free?
faq.a1: Yes! All features currently provided by Super Toolbox Pro (including high-precision PaddleOCR, ID photo background remover, collage maker, batch compression, format converter, photo filter, and QR code tools) are completely free to the public with no paywall.
faq.q2: Will my images, files, or personal data be uploaded to your server?
faq.a2: Never! This project is powered by pure client-side WebAssembly neural network inference engines and Canvas pipelines. All image processing and document recognition runs 100% inside your local browser memory. No data ever leaves your device.
faq.q3: Does it support offline use or installation as a desktop app?
faq.a3: Yes! The platform fully supports the PWA (Progressive Web App) standard. In Chrome, Edge, or mobile browsers, click the 'Install App' icon to save it as a standalone desktop or mobile application. Once models are loaded, it works seamlessly even without an internet connection.
faq.q4: What model powers the local OCR? Does it support multi-page PDFs?
faq.a4: The engine is based on Baidu PaddleOCR (PP-OCRv6) lightweight deep learning offline models, accelerated by ONNX Runtime Web multithreaded WASM for sub-second recognition. It deeply integrates PDF.js to support page-by-page rendering or batch full-text extraction, with direct export to Word (.docx), aligned Excel (.xlsx), and plain text (.txt).
